changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'FieldType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[FieldType]( [ID] int IDENTITY(1,1) not null, [Name] nvarchar(128) not null, FriendlyName nvarchar(250) not null, Description nvarchar(4000) null, DisplayDescription nvarchar(4000) null, FormDescription nvarchar(4000) null, [Type] varchar(25) not null, LookupObjectType varchar(25) null, LookupObjectID int null, LookupDisplayFormat nvarchar(250) null, MinimumLength decimal(38, 18) null, MaximumLength decimal(38, 18) null, [Length] int null, [Pattern] varchar(1000) null, [Object] varchar(50) constraint CK_FieldType_Object default('') not null, ObjectID int constraint CK_FieldType_ObjectID default(0) not null, SortOrder int constraint CK_FieldType_SortOrder default(0) not null, IsRequired bit constraint CK_FieldType_IsRequired default(0) not null, IsListable bit constraint CK_FieldType_IsListable default(0) not null, ValidationDescription nvarchar(500) null, [Category] nvarchar(250) null, IsDisplayable bit constraint DF_FieldType_IsDisplayable default(1) not null, IsEditable bit constraint DF_FieldType_IsEditable default(1) not null, [DefaultValue] nvarchar(max) null, DefaultFormattedValue nvarchar(max) null, AllowAllValue bit constraint DF_FieldType_AllowAllValue default(0) not null, AllowAllLabel nvarchar(250) null, IsPrimaryFilter bit constraint CK_FieldType_IsPrimaryFilter default(0) not null, LookupEditFormat nvarchar(250) null, IsPartOfKey bit constraint DF_FieldType_IsPartOfKey default(0) not null, ColumnOrder int constraint DF_FieldType_ColumnOrder default(1) not null, ColumnWidth int null, LookupObjectFieldTypeID int null, AllowMultipleValues bit constraint DF_FieldType_AllowMultipleValues default(0) not null, AssetTypeID int sparse, ParentFieldTypeID int constraint DF_FieldType_ParentFieldTypeID default(0) not null, UpdatedBy int constraint DF_FieldType_UpdatedBy default(0) not null, [Increment] decimal(38, 18) null, [Precision] int null, FilterPredicateID int null, FilterPredicateDirection bit null, FilterFieldTypeID int null, ShowIfEmpty bit constraint DF_FieldType_ShowIfEmpty default(0) not null, [Definition] nvarchar(2500) constraint DF_FieldType_Definition default('{}') not null, ScoreType int null, SearchAddToResult bit constraint DF_FieldType_SearchAddToResult default(0) not null, SearchPrefix nvarchar(250) null, SearchSuffix nvarchar(250) null, SearchDisplayOrder int null, CounterPrefix nvarchar(10) null, CounterInitialIndex int null, DisplayInColumn bit null, SortByAscending bit constraint DF_FieldType_SortByAscending default(1) not null, IntersectTypeID int sparse, IssueTypeID int sparse, UseDisplayFormat bit constraint DF_FieldType_UseDisplayFormat default(0) not null, IsSubject bit constraint DF_FieldType_IsSubject default(1) not null constraint [PK_FieldType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_FieldType_ObjectID_Type') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_FieldType_ObjectID_Type] ON [dbo].[FieldType] ([ObjectID], [Type]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_FieldType_LookupObjectType_LookupObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_FieldType_LookupObjectType_LookupObjectID] ON [dbo].[FieldType] ( [LookupObjectType] ASC, [LookupObjectID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_FieldType_Object-ObjectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_FieldType_Object-ObjectID] ON [dbo].[FieldType] ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_FieldType_Type') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_FieldType_Type] ON [dbo].[FieldType] ( [Type] ASC ) INCLUDE([LookupObjectType],[LookupObjectID],[LookupDisplayFormat],[AllowMultipleValues]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_FieldType_IntersectTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_FieldType_IntersectTypeID] ON [dbo].[FieldType] ( [IntersectTypeID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_FieldType_IssueTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_FieldType_IssueTypeID] ON [dbo].[FieldType] ( [IssueTypeID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'UQ_FieldType_AssetType_Name') BEGIN CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [UQ_FieldType_AssetType_Name] ON [dbo].[FieldType] ( [AssetTypeID] ASC, [Name] ASC ) WHERE ([AssetTypeID] IS NOT NULL) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'UQ_FieldType_IntersectType_Name') BEGIN CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [UQ_FieldType_IntersectType_Name] ON [dbo].[FieldType] ( [IntersectTypeID] ASC, [Name] ASC ) WHERE ([IntersectTypeID] IS NOT NULL) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'UQ_FieldType_IssueType_Name') BEGIN CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [UQ_FieldType_IssueType_Name] ON [dbo].[FieldType] ( [IssueTypeID] ASC, [Name] ASC ) WHERE ([IssueTypeID] IS NOT NULL) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'UQ_FieldType_Object_Name') BEGIN CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [UQ_FieldType_Object_Name] ON [dbo].[FieldType] ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC, [Name] ASC ) WHERE ([Object] is not null and [ObjectID] IS NOT NULL and ObjectID <> 0) END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[FieldType_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[FieldType] FOR INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON;
UPDATE T SET T.AssetTypeID = A.ID FROM FieldType T inner join inserted F on F.ID = T.ID and T.AssetTypeID is null inner join AssetType A on A.Object = F.Object and A.ObjectID = F.ObjectID;

changeSet.author: bquinlivan
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[FieldType_AfterUpsert] ON [dbo].[FieldType] AFTER INSERT,UPDATE AS BEGIN IF ((substring( columns_updated() , 1 , 1 ) & power( 2, 6 ) > 0) or (substring( columns_updated() , 1 , 1 ) & power( 2, 7 ) > 0) or (substring( columns_updated() , 2 , 1 ) & power( 2, 0 ) > 0) or (substring( columns_updated() , 2 , 1 ) & power( 2, 1 ) > 0) or (substring( columns_updated() , 5 , 1 ) & power( 2, 1 ) > 0)) BEGIN
UPDATE F set F.FormattedValue = utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValueWithMultiple(FT.Type, FT.LookupDisplayFormat, FT.LookupObjectType, FT.LookupObjectID, F.Value, FT.AllowMultipleValues) FROM Field F inner join inserted FT on FT.ID = F.FieldTypeID and FT.LookupObjectType is not null END
IF ((substring( columns_updated() , 3 , 1 ) & power( 2, 7 ) > 0) or (substring( columns_updated() , 4 , 1 ) & power( 2, 0 ) > 0)) BEGIN update FT set FT.defaultformattedvalue = [utility].[GetFormattedFieldLookupValueWrapper](FT.[Type],FT.[LookupDisplayFormat],FT.[LookupObjectType],FT.[LookupObjectID],FT.[DefaultValue]) from FieldType FT inner join inserted ins on ins.ID = FT.ID and ins.LookupObjectType is not null
update FT set FT.defaultformattedvalue = [utility].[GetFormattedFieldLookupValueWrapper](FT.[Type],FT.[LookupDisplayFormat],FT.[LookupObjectType],FT.[LookupObjectID],FT.[DefaultValue]) from FieldType FT inner join inserted ins on ins.ID = FT.ID and ins.LookupObjectType is null and FT.Type='Link' END
IF (EXISTS (SELECT * FROM DELETED)) BEGIN INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) SELECT 'Update' ,CASE WHEN i.IntersectTypeID is not null THEN [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'IntersectType', i.IntersectTypeID, i.UpdatedBy) WHEN i.IssueTypeID is not null THEN [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'IssueType', i.IssueTypeID, i.UpdatedBy) ELSE [queue].WriteIndexXml('', A.Object, A.ObjectID, i.UpdatedBy) END as Custom , 'FieldType' , i.ID FROM inserted i LEFT JOIN AssetType A on A.ID = i.AssetTypeID END ELSE IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM DELETED)) BEGIN INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Add' ,CASE WHEN i.IntersectTypeID is not null THEN [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'IntersectType', i.IntersectTypeID, i.UpdatedBy) WHEN i.IssueTypeID is not null THEN [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'IssueType', i.IssueTypeID, i.UpdatedBy) ELSE [queue].WriteIndexXml('', A.Object, A.ObjectID, i.UpdatedBy) END as Custom , 'FieldType' , i.ID FROM inserted i LEFT JOIN AssetType A on A.ID = i.AssetTypeID END END;
